自编复制恢复测试：下方引用本项目的讲解稿代码。

```javascript
(function (root, factory) {
  const api = factory();

  if (typeof module === "object" && module.exports) {
    module.exports = api;
  } else {
    root.WhoPresentation = api;
  }
})(this, function () {
  const clean = v => typeof v === "string" ? v.trim() : "";

  function build(
    result,
    {
      duration = "180",
      audience = "peer",
      offset = 0,
      name = "代码片段"
    } = {}
  ) {
    const max = duration === "30" ? 2 : duration === "300" ? 8 : 5;

    const all = Array.isArray(result.blocks) ? result.blocks : [];

    const main = all.filter(
      b => !all.some(
        p =>
          p !== b &&
          p.start <= b.start &&
          p.end >= b.end &&
          (p.start < b.start || p.end > b.end)
      )
    );

    const chosen = (main.length ? main : all).slice(0, max);

    const label =
      audience === "nontechnical"
        ? "非技术听众"
        : audience === "review"
          ? "代码评审"
          : "同事交流";

    const sections = [];

    if (!chosen.length) {
      return {
        title: "暂时还不能生成可靠的讲解稿",
        sections: [],
        questions: [],
        note: "没有读到可对应源码的模块。请补全片段、选择语言明确的文件，或配置 AI 后重试。",
        name
      };
    }

    sections.push({
      title: "先说明这份代码",
      text: `我这次说明的是 ${name}${
        offset
          ? ` 中从第 ${offset + 1} 行开始选取的片段`
          : ""
      }。${
        result.mode === "ai"
          ? clean(result.purpose)
          : "我会重点介绍" +
            chosen.map(b => "「" + clean(b.title) + "」").join("、") +
            "，说明它们处理的内容和结果。"
      }\n下面按源码中的组织顺序展开；这个顺序不等于实际调用顺序。`,
      evidence: "范围说明",
      index: null
    });

    chosen.forEach((b, i) => {
      const children = all.filter(
        c => c !== b && c.start >= b.start && c.end <= b.end
      );

      let text = `${i === 0 ? "先看" : "接着看"}「${clean(b.title)}」。${
        clean(b.flow) ||
        clean(b.purpose) ||
        "这部分的具体作用仍需要补充上下文。"
      }`;

      if (!b.flow && children.length) {
        text +=
          "\n其中可以看到：" +
          children
            .slice(0, duration === "30" ? 1 : 3)
            .map(c => clean(c.purpose))
            .join("\n");
      }

      if (duration !== "30") {
        if (clean(b.inputs)) {
          text += `\n它接收的内容是：${clean(b.inputs)}`;
        }

        if (clean(b.output)) {
          text += `\n这一部分的结果：${clean(b.output)}`;
        }

        if (audience === "review" && clean(b.dependencies)) {
          text += `\n需要一起确认的是：${clean(b.dependencies)}`;
        }

        if (audience === "nontechnical" && clean(b.concept)) {
          text += `\n换个角度理解：${clean(b.concept)}`;
        }
      }

      sections.push({
        title: clean(b.title),
        text,
        evidence:
          result.mode === "ai" ? "AI 解读 · 待核对" : "本地规则解读",
        index: all.indexOf(b),
        start: b.start + offset,
        end: b.end + offset
      });
    });

    sections.push({
      title: "最后交代范围",
      text: `以上覆盖了${chosen.length}个主要部分。${
        chosen.length < main.length
          ? `还有 ${main.length - chosen.length} 个部分没有在这份简稿中展开。`
          : ""
      }这次没有执行代码，也没有检查整个项目，因此实际运行结果、外部依赖和作者的设计动机还需要进一步核对。`,
      evidence: "已知边界",
      index: null
    });

    const questions = chosen
      .slice(0, duration === "30" ? 1 : 4)
      .map(b => ({
        question: `为什么需要「${clean(b.title)}」？`,
        answer: `从当前片段可以说明它的作用：${clean(b.purpose)}\n这说明了代码在做什么，但不能据此确认作者为什么选择它，而没有选择其他写法。`,
        index: all.indexOf(b)
      }));

    questions.push({
      question: "这段代码已经验证能正常运行了吗？",
      answer: "这里进行了结构读取和解释，没有执行程序。要确认运行结果，需要项目依赖、调用方式和实际测试。",
      index: null
    });

    return {
      title: `${name} · 讲解稿`,
      sections,
      questions,
      name,
      note: `${label} · ${
        duration === "30"
          ? "30 秒提纲"
          : duration === "300"
            ? "5 分钟展开"
            : "3 分钟说明"
      }（目标时长，以实际朗读为准） · ${
        result.mode === "ai"
          ? "依据 AI 分析整理，需核对"
          : "依据本地分析整理，复杂业务含义可能缺失"
      }。选中内容按完整行读取。${
        Array.isArray(result.warnings) && result.warnings.length
          ? "\n注意：" + result.warnings.join("；")
          : ""
      }`
    };
  }

  function markdown(p) {
    return (
      `# ${p.title}\n\n${p.note}\n\n` +
      p.sections
        .map(
          s =>
            `## ${s.title}\n\n${s.text}\n\n${
              s.start ? `源码：第 ${s.start}—${s.end} 行 · ` : ""
            }${s.evidence}`
        )
        .join("\n\n") +
      "\n\n## 可能被追问\n\n" +
      p.questions
        .map(q => `### ${q.question}\n\n${q.answer}`)
        .join("\n\n")
    );
  }

  return { build, markdown };
});
```
